description: Clean single-column book, 300 pages with outline, headers, footers, and uniform typography.

sentences: In a world of constant notification and fleeting attention, deep reading remains one of humanity's finest arts.
A book demands patience, tactile familiarity, and a quiet space free from algorithmic interruptions.
When software honors the calm nature of paper, the reader ceases to notice the digital medium.
Paragraph 2.1 continues the exploration into structured knowledge systems.
Every thought captured in the margin forms an indelible thread in the personal tapestry of comprehension.
We observe that the physical sensation of turning pages anchors memory far deeper than transient scrolling.
Therefore, continuous scroll must retain the deliberate spatial landmarks of discrete pagination.
